#112 · Drill Pokémon

Rhydon

Ground Rock

Kanto · Generation 1

Rhydon is a Ground/Rock-type Drill Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.9 m tall and weighs 120 kg. It evolves from Rhyhorn and into Rhyperior. Its highest base stat is Attack (130), with a base stat total of 485.
